LanguageData.EXB_OverloadDesc: Armor-color bonus x{0}: blue/industrial red 1.5, gold 2.5, independent of core quality. Extra movement, complete-mech weapon damage and melee range all use the same x{0} factor. Eligible limb drain {1}/game second; regeneration {2}. Stops at zero energy. Count core plus four limbs: civilian 1, military 2; 1-5 blue, 6-10 gold. Industrial core forces red.
LanguageData.EXB_Empty: No energy. Wait for automatic regeneration.
LanguageData.EXB_RemoveLimbsDesc: Detach all limb modules beside the pawn, preserving IDs and tiers. No doctor, medicine or anesthesia required. The permanent core remains.
LanguageData.EXB_RemovalDesc: Manage metal armor, install, replace and detach limb modules on this page.
LanguageData.EXB_RemovalHint: Detach immediately without medical work. Original IDs and tiers are preserved, and original limbs remain intact.
LanguageData.EXB_RemovalCoreRule: Permanent core: medical upgrades to higher tiers only, no removal/refund. Remove industrial modules before upgrading to a non-industrial core.
LanguageData.EXB_RemovalMissing: This body part is missing and cannot receive a module.
LanguageData.EXB_RemovalEmpty: No module here. Approach a module on the ground and right-click to install it.
LanguageData.EXB_RemovalReturnNote: Preserves ID and tier; no quality
LanguageData.EXB_RemovalFailed: Could not detach {0}. The pawn state changed, the module was already removed, or no placement was possible. No duplicate item was returned.
LanguageData.EXB_RemovalDone: Detached {0}; the original-tier module was placed beside this pawn.
LanguageData.EXB_RemovalPartial: Returned {0} / {1} modules. Modules that could not be returned remain installed.
LanguageData.EXB_RemovalAllDone: Detached and returned {0} limb modules. The core and natural limbs remain intact.
LanguageData.EXB_DirectUnavailable: Requires an awake, standing, player-controlled colonist.
LanguageData.EXB_DirectUnreachable: Cannot reach or reserve this module.
LanguageData.EXB_EnergyRatesTip: Regeneration: {0}/game second; overload drain from all available limbs: {1}/game second. The bar turns amber at 20% energy or below.
LanguageData.EXB_MechSet: Exoskeleton set: {0}/4. Overload transforms into the mech and enables its built-in weapons only with both arms and both legs installed. Mixed tiers and qualities count. Partial sets keep normal overload bonuses. Each pawn uses independent energy.
LanguageData.EXB_IndustrialCoreRequired: Industrial modules require an industrial core.
LanguageData.EXB_MetalArmorCleared: Cleared. Remaining metal was returned to this pawn's inventory.
LanguageData.EXB_MetalArmorFailed: Insufficient or inaccessible material, or refund failed. Existing armor and resources are unchanged.
LanguageData.EXB_MetalArmorColumns: Metal / available / cost / maximum durability including core quality
LanguageData.EXB_MetalArmorInstructions: 100 metal creates an armor health bar. Maximum = 100 x metal hit-point factor x core quality. Absorbs 75% of health damage at equal durability cost. Depletion retracts the mech and disables its core for 2 in-game hours. Clear or replace to refund remaining metal.
LanguageData.EXB_MetalArmorTip: Complete-mech metal health absorbs 75% of incoming health damage, spending one durability per absorbed damage. Any shortage passes through. No extra random metal armor roll. Depletion instantly retracts the mech and disables limb bonuses, energy recovery and overload for 2 in-game hours. Recovery allows empty-armor transformation. Core quality scales maximum durability. Body-part health still uses the color multiplier x1.5/x2.5. Deactivation keeps durability. Refundable metal: {0}.
LanguageData.EXB_CoreDamageStatus: Core damaged: offline for 2 in-game hours. Limb bonuses, energy recovery and overload are disabled.
LanguageData.EXB_MetalArmorQuality: Core quality: {0}; maximum durability x{1}; absorbs 75%
LanguageData.EXB_ManagementHint: Select a real module to fetch and install. Replacement consumes the new module and returns the old one on success. Actions affect only the displayed pawn.
LanguageData.EXB_ManageArmorNoCore: No core installed. Install a core through surgery to manage metal armor here.
LanguageData.EXB_ManageMetalStock: Selected metal: {0} / 100 units available; reloaded maximum {1}. Absorbs 75% of health damage; clearing/replacing refunds the remaining metal fraction.
LanguageData.EXB_ManageInstallFailed: Module unavailable, wrong body part, or unreachable. Existing installation unchanged.
LanguageData.EXB_ManageNoStock: No accessible module fits this body part. Industrial modules need an industrial core.
